scientific_preregistration_card.observed: RK13 closed seven-method terminal actual sets on 18 development records, but dense_budget_step_auc_v2 was null and unified time-matched comparison remained open.
scientific_preregistration_card.problem: Determine whether the LinearDesign-11 terminal-set advantage persists under real ordered generation-call prefixes rather than inferred or padded curves.
scientific_preregistration_card.hypothesis: Across the same 18 development records, LinearDesign-11 has positive paired effects against codonGPT, uniform synonymous sampling, and EnsembleDesign-11 for both B1..B10 dense AUC and B11 normalized hypervolume.
scientific_preregistration_card.data: Frozen seed-0 raw ordered outputs and independently verified objective values from RK12/RK13; no new protein records, labels, functional test rows, or OOD rows.
scientific_preregistration_card.controls: Frozen official LinearDesign lambda ordering and official EnsembleDesign run ordering; original legacy codonGPT and uniform output order; original normalized hypervolume references.
scientific_preregistration_card.primary_metric: Reference: LinearDesign-11 minus each comparator. Metrics: real generation-call dense_budget_step_auc_v2 over B1..B10 and normalized hypervolume at B11. N=18 paired records; 20000 bootstrap resamples; six-test Holm family.
scientific_preregistration_card.secondary_metric: Descriptive B1..B100 codonGPT and uniform curves only; these do not replace the common four-method B11 primary comparison.
scientific_preregistration_card.allowed_conclusion: A common-budget surrogate-efficiency comparison for four methods on 18 development records, with exact raw-prefix provenance.
scientific_preregistration_card.forbidden_conclusion: No time-matched, SOTA, functional-OOD, external-SOTA authorization, CodonFlow-RK improvement, or full seven-method dense ranking claim.

budget_semantics: One objective vector at every real ordered generation call B=1,...,Bmax. Repeated sequences remain at their original call positions and reuse the independently verified objective for that exact sequence. No deduplication-induced budget shift, padding, synthetic origin, or zero-filled budgets.
dense_prefix_superiority_rule: All six paired effects must be positive, their percentile 95% CI must exclude zero, and Holm-adjusted two-sided p must be below 0.05. Per-comparator two-metric results are also reported separately.

exclusions.gemorna: Legacy artifacts retain first-occurrence unique valid sequences and 100-request totals, but not the repeated raw calls; generation-call budgets therefore cannot be reconstructed without inventing positions.
exclusions.lineardesign_scan: Legacy artifacts retain first-occurrence unique valid sequences but not repeated raw calls; generation-call budgets therefore cannot be reconstructed without inventing positions.
exclusions.cai_greedy: Only one real output exists, so a B1..B11 trajectory and AUC cannot be formed.

time_matched_null_reason: The sole RTX 5090 was occupied by unrelated real experiments at protocol freeze; shared or retroactively allocated timings are not controlled end-to-end costs. No process was killed and no timing was imputed.
